description_en: Performs a conditional query to retrieve the list of gateways under the current user account based on filter conditions
description_zh: 根据过滤条件查询当前用户账号名下的网关信息列表
name: ListGateways

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters gateways by online or offline status. If you do not specify this parameter, the online status is not limited. Valid values:

ONLINE: Online.

OFFLINE: Offline
parameters.help_zh:
网关的在线、离线状态过滤。如未传入此参数，则不限制在线状态。可取值为：

ONLINE：在线。

OFFLINE：离线
parameters.name: online_state

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy filter for the GwEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_gw_eui

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy filter for the city name
parameters.name: fuzzy_city

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy filter for the gateway name
parameters.name: fuzzy_name

parameters.help_en: The filter for the gateway frequency band ID
parameters.name: freq_band_plan_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters gateways by enabled or disabled status. If you do not specify this parameter, the enabled status is not limited. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
网关的启用、停用状态过滤。如未传入此参数，则不限制启停状态。可取值为：

true：启用。

false：停用
parameters.name: is_enabled

parameters.help_en: The starting position of the current query. The value starts from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of gateways to return in the current query. Maximum value: 200. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的网关数量上限，最大支持200，须大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: Specifies the field by which to sort the results. Valid value: ONLINE_STATE_CHANGED_MILLIS
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为ONLINE_STATE_CHANGED_MILLIS
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
Used together with the SortingField parameter. Valid values:

true: Ascending order.

false: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
配合SortingField参数一起使用。

true：升序。

false：降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_zh: 查询到的网关信息列表

Address.description_en: The detailed address of the gateway

AddressCode.description_en: The ID of the region where the gateway is located. It is defined by `http://lbs.amap.com/api/javascript-api/download`

AuthTypes.description_en:
The contract type of the gateway. Valid values:

HYBRID: Hybrid gateway.

SINGLE_CHANNEL: Single-channel gateway.

STANDARD: Standard contract gateway
AuthTypes.description_zh:
网关合约类型。

HYBRID：hybrid网关。

SINGLE_CHANNEL：单通道网关。

STANDARD：标准合约网关

ChargeStatus.description_en:
The overdue payment status of the gateway. Valid values:

NORMAL: The gateway has no overdue payments and works normally.
ARREARAGE: The gateway has overdue payments
ChargeStatus.description_zh:
网关欠费状态。

NORMAL：网关未欠费，正常工作。
ARREARAGE：网关欠费

City.description_en: The name of the city where the gateway is located

ClassBSupported.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway supports the Class B mode
ClassBSupported.description_zh: 该网关是否支持Class B模式

ClassBWorking.description_en:
Indicates whether the gateway is working in Class B mode. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
ClassBWorking.description_zh:
该网关是否正工作在Class B模式下。

true：是。

false：否

CommunicationMode.description_en:
The communication mode of the gateway. Valid values:

FULL_DUPLEX: Full-duplex.

HALF_DUPLEX: Half-duplex
CommunicationMode.description_zh:
网关通信模式。可取值为：

FULL_DUPLEX：全双工。

HALF_DUPLEX：半双工

Description.description_en: The custom description of the gateway

District.description_en: The name of the district where the gateway is located

EmbeddedNsId.description_en: The ID of the hybrid gateway

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the gateway is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
该网关是否处于启用状态。

true：启用状态。

false：停用状态

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID of the gateway

GisCoordinateSystem.description_en: The coordinate system used for the longitude and latitude of the gateway. Valid values: WGS_84 and GCJ_02
GisCoordinateSystem.description_zh: 网关经纬度所采用的坐标系统，可取值为WGS_84，GCJ_02

GwEui.description_en: The unique identifier of the gateway

Name.description_en: The custom name of the gateway

OnlineState.description_en:
The online or offline status of the gateway. Valid values:

ONLINE: Online.

OFFLINE: Offline
OnlineState.description_zh:
网关的在线、离线状态。可取值为：

ONLINE：在线。

OFFLINE：离线

OnlineStateChangedMillis.description_en:
The time when the online or offline status was last changed.

The time is in the UNIX timestamp format, in milliseconds
OnlineStateChangedMillis.description_zh:
最近一次在线、离线状态的变更时间。

格式为UNIX时间戳，以毫秒为单位

TimeCorrectable.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway can be used as a time correction gateway
TimeCorrectable.description_zh: 该网关是否可以作为时间校准网关

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of gateways that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的网关总数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
